description: A large, dark, scaly theropod with a long tail and a crest along its back stands on a muddy shore, mouth open to show serrated teeth. Behind it are araucaria-type conifers, ferns and driftwood, with choppy grey water to the right and a stormy sky. Two long-necked sauropods are faintly visible on the far shore. No text, signature or border is visible, and nothing is bloody.
